Name: (CR) Kisaa's Cliffside Cove Farm
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[i][center][size=3]﻿﻿Welcome to the [b]Cliffside Cove Farm[/b]: A cliffside beach farm with a secret cove.[/size]
[size=2](Originally made with my siren farmer in mind!)[/size][/center][/i]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Farm added through AdditionalFarms: [/b]Does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu on starting a new save!
[*][b]Custom starter giftbox items: [/b]Choose before starting a new save!
[*][b]Diggable grass tiles: [/b]There are designated crop plots prepared, but feel free to dig in anywhere!
[*][b]Custom fish/crab pot catch pool: [/b]Fish for river fish in the east river and ocean fish in the beach.
[*][b]Forest/beach forage and respawning hardwood stumps: [/b]If you don't want this, [i][b]delete the [FTM] CR Cliffside Cove Farm folder.[/b][/i]
[*][b]Custom farm cave (toggleable) and starter farmhouse layout[/b]
[*][b]Supports 8-person multiplayer![/b]
[*][b]Farm customization[/b]
[*][b]Secrets! ;)[/b]
[/list]
[size=3]This mod is inspired by Sharogg's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24830]Puffin Cliff Farm[/url] (and its predecessor [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7038]Puffin Cove Farm[/url]﻿). Go check them out!

Want to adjust these features to your liking? You can do it all in the mod config! Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easier in-game customization.

[/size][i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Starter Gift: [/b]Changes stuff you get from the starter gift box.
[*][b]Available options:[/b] Farmer (15x Parsnip Seeds), Fisher (10x Coal, 2x Fish Smoker).
[*][b]Secret Cove: [/b]Enables custom farm cave. [b][i]Set to false if using other modded farm caves.[/i][/b]
[*][b]Island Dock: [/b]Toggles the fishing dock on the island.
[*][b]Ocean Ambience: [/b]Toggles ocean waves ambience.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, etc.
[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue, Eemie.
[b][u]Not Compatible[/u] [/b]with mods that replace FarmCave.tmx (unless this mod's config is set to false).

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Cliffside Cove Farm" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Do not install this mod on an existing save file, as it will result in wrong debris/object/building spawns.
[*]One of the lowermost tiles on the shoreline lets you clip to the sea; I haven't found a solution for this.
[*]Sometimes walking out of the farm cave (when Secret Cove is set to [i]true[/i]) is difficult. To mitigate this, walk forward a few tiles from the shoreline, then walk back to the exit.
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me.
[/list]
[size=3]As usual please report any bugs here on Nexus, or you can reach out to me (crystalinerose) in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Modding Discord[/url]﻿ for a faster response.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod!
